neighbours.label: Fires inside telecommunications transmission jargon: multiplexing schemes, fiber-optic and radio link types, carrier line rates and interference types, often peaking on the punctuation or piece inside an acronym (WDM, OC-768); quiet on parenthesized acronyms and cable talk from other engineering fields.
fire: The operator replaced its copper trunks with dense wavelength multiplexing (DWDM) links.
Each base station suffers from fading and multipath echoes off nearby towers.
The ISP leased an OC-192 circuit to connect its two data centers.
Time-division multiple access (TDMA) splits each radio channel into slots.
The campus backbone runs on single-mode fiber with 10GBASE-LR optics.
Engineers measured crosstalk and dispersion on the long-haul optical span.
Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) spreads data across many subcarriers.
The satellite uplink uses Ku-band transponders and a backup microwave hop.
quiet: The landlord replaced the old boiler with a heating and ventilation (HVAC) unit.
Each office suffers from noise and drafts off the nearby elevator shaft.
The bank leased a downtown floor to connect its two trading teams.
The general data protection regulation (GDPR) splits each consent form into sections.
The campus parking lot runs on a single permit with color-coded zones.
Engineers measured settlement and cracking on the long concrete span.
The annual percentage rate (APR) spreads interest across many monthly payments.
The suspension bridge uses steel cables and a backup concrete pier.

predictions: 6-7/8 fire >= 0.25 (probes: OC-768 0.97, WDM 0.93, multipath 0.50, multimode fiber 0.29, SWIR 0.24); near misses < 0.1 (steel cable 0.00).
notes: Probes (fraction of max 132): 'division multiplexing (WDM)' 0.93 on ' (', 'OC-768 network' 0.97 on '-', 'multipath and multiple-user' 0.50, 'multimode fiber-optic' 0.29, SWIR sensor 0.24; bridge cable and orchestra strings ~0. Patanjali (0.55) is a side peak not tested here. Near misses keep the parenthesized acronym but move to building, finance or civil engineering.
